user.title: MegaFon sign in
user.description: Phone number plus the three x-cabinet-* headers: open lk.megafon.ru, DevTools → Network → any request to api.megafon.ru → copy the values of x-cabinet-check-info / x-cabinet-id-param / x-cabinet-validation-param (or paste the whole request as cURL — the UUIDs are parsed automatically).

otp.title: SMS code
otp.description: Enter the code from the SMS.

cookie.title: Browser session (fallback)
cookie.description: Used when the SMS flow hits a captcha or the data calls still need browser headers. Paste the Cookie header and the three x-cabinet-* headers from DevTools.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication required
reauth_confirm.description: The MegaFon session has expired. Press Submit — an SMS with a new code will be sent to your number.

reauth_otp.title: SMS code
reauth_otp.description: Enter the code from the SMS.

error.invalid_auth: The session is invalid or expired
error.invalid_phone: The number was rejected (not a MegaFon subscriber?)
error.invalid_headers: All three x-cabinet-* UUIDs are required — paste the headers or the request as cURL
